sentences.english: There was a messy · pile of clothes on the floor.

sentences.russian: Она нашла птичье · перо на земле.

sentences.english: I · suspect he is hiding something from us.

sentences.russian: У неё на столе была огромная · груда бумаг.

sentences.english: A lightning · flash lit up the dark sky.
sentences.russian: · Вспышка молнии осветила тёмное небо.

sentences.english: The gardener trimmed the rose · bush in the yard.
